title.zh: 蚂蚁百灵开源Ling-3.1增强版，560B预训练底座同步放出
title.en: 蚂蚁百灵开源Ling-3.1增强版，560B预训练底座同步放出

current_state.zh: Ant Group's Ling team released the weights of Ling-3.1-flash-1019 under the MIT license, along with a 560B-parameter BF16 base checkpoint. The model is a 25B-active-parameter mixture-of-experts model whose post-training improves reasoning and Agent performance.
